name: Engineering Physics Laboratory - IV
description:
The course consists of a total of 6-8 experiments. The experiments will expose the students to learn the methodologies for construction of phase diagram for binary solid state systems; deposition of thin films of metals/semimetals using physical vapor deposition methods and analyze their electrical properties; study of the electrical and magnetic properties of superconductors; 
studying the behavior of tunnel magnetoresistance (TMR) in magnetic tunnel junctions; structural characterization of materials using X-ray diffraction, etc.
